channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Vijay Amritraj honoured with Padma Bhushan; Harmanpreet Kaur, Savita Punia gets Padma Shri
item.description: Tennis icon Vijay Amritraj receives India’s third-highest civilian honour as multiple sportspersons are recognised in Padma Awards 2026.

item.title: Tom Boon hat-trick powers Ranchi Royals into Hockey India League 2026 final
item.description: Ranchi Royals overcome Hyderabad Toofans 3-2 in Qualifier 2 to seal final date with Vedanta Kalinga Lancers.

item.title: PWL 2026: Haryana Thunders knock Tiigers of Mumbai Capitals out of play-off contention
item.description: Haryana Thunders dominated the Capitals, securing a convincing 6-3 victory to climb to the top of the points table.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess Wijk aan Zee: Gukesh bounces back with a win after two straight losses
item.description: Gukesh defeated Vladimir Fedoseev of Slovenia in the 8th round with the black pieces.

item.title: India outclasses Pakistan 4-1 to secure Silver at SAFF Futsal Championship 2026
item.description: Dominant second-half display helps India finish runners-up in Bangkok on Republic Day.

item.title: Badminton player Krishna Prasad Garaga cleared as Anti-Doping Panel quashes four-year ban
item.description: Indian wrestler Bajrang Punia has received temporary relief in his anti-doping case after the Anti-Doping Appeal Panel (ADAP) ruled that the matter needs to be examined again due to procedural lapses.

item.title: Kalinga Lancers defeat Ranchi Royals to win Men’s Hockey India League title
item.description: Home side edge Ranchi Royals 3-2 in a close final at Bhubaneswar to lift the HIL crown.

item.title: Nat Sciver-Brunt becomes first player to score a century in Women’s Premier League
item.description: Brunt's milestone innings helps the Mumbai Indians to register an important win in a must-win clash against RCB.

item.title: Yuki Bhambri- Andre knocked out in third round of Australian Open
item.description: Unseeded Brazilian pair end India’s last remaining challenge at Melbourne Park.

item.title: PWL 2026: Punjab Royals register a crucial victory over Maharashtra Kesari
item.description: The crucial wins from Ana Godinez and Sandeep Singh Mann led Punjab to a close 5-4 win over Maharashtra.
